clienttimeout.title: Isikhathi sokulinda isicelo siphelile

upstream.title: Iseva ayitholakali

invalid_configuration.title: Ukucushwa okungavumelekile

ssl-https-http.title: Isicelo esingalungile
ssl-https-http.description: Le webhusayithi ifinyeleleka nge-HTTPS. Uzamile ukuxhuma nge-HTTP; manje sizozama ukukuqondisa kabusha. Uma ungaqondiswa kabusha, sicela wengeze u-https:// ekuqaleni kwe-URL yakho bese uzama futhi.

unsupported_method.title: Indlela engasekelwa

ssl-insecure.title: Isicelo esingaphephile
ssl-insecure.description: Iphrothokholi ye-HTTPS eceliwe ayivuliwe kule webhusayithi. Sicela ubuyekeze isiphequluli sakho.

maintenance.title: Ivaliwe ukuze ilungiswe
